spans.s:
m. (-वः)
1 The penis.
2 A snake.
3 Heighth, elevation.
4 Happiness.
ind. (-वम्)
Hail, homage, a term of exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities.
E.
शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्.

(ऋ) षेवृ r. 1st cl. (सेवति-ते)
1 To serve, to gratify by service.
2 To rely or depend on.
3 To worship.
4 To follow, to practise, to be addicted to.

(ऋ) सेवृ r. 1st cl. (सेवते)
To serve, to gratify by service: preferably षेवृ.

f. (-वा)
1 Service, servitude.
2 Worship, homage.
3 Addition to.
E.
षेव to serve, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-धिः)
A treasure as belonging to KUVERA, a Nidhi or substance of extraordinary rarity and value, possessed only by the god of wealth.
E.
शेव happiness, धा to have, कि aff.; or शे in future, अवधि boundary.

m. (-धिः)
A divine treasure, a substance considered as the treasure of KUVERA.
E.
सेव service, धा to have, aff. कि; also शेवधि.

n. (-लं)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra): see the next.

n. (-लं)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् Uṇādi aff.; also व being changed to प, शेपाल, and the pen. vowel shortened, शेवल; also शैवल, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Servile, dependant.
m. (-कः)
1 A sack.
2 A servant.
E.
षेव to serve, or षिव to sew, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-लुः)
A plant, commonly Dugdhapeya.

n. (-नं)
1 Sewing, darning, stitching.
2 A sack.
3

Service.
4

Using, practising, following, being addicted to, or fond of.
f. (-नी)
1 A needle.
2 (In anatomy,) A peculiar union of parts, of which seven instances occur in the body: viz. the five sutures of the cranium, the frenum of the tongue, and that of the glans penis.
E.
षिव to sew, or षेव to serve, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be served, waited on, or honoured.
2 To be followed or practised.
E.
सेव to serve, अनीयर् aff.; also सेवितव्य and सेव्य.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Serving, attending on.
2 Pursuing, practising, being addicted to.
E.
सेव, and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Served, obeyed, honoured, worshipped, adored.
2 Protected, preserved.
3 Pursued, practised, used.
E.
षेवृ to gratify by service, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Who or what serves, worships, &c.
2 Addicted or devoted to.
E.
सेवृ to serve, तृच् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Serving, devotion.
E.
सेविन् who serves, त्व aff.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
1 Serving, obeying.
2 Pursuing, practising, using.
E.
षेव to serve, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be served or obeyed, to be worshipped or honoured.
2 What ought or may be practised, used, &c.
3 To be taken care of.
n. (-व्यं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
m. (-व्यः)
A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.)
f. (-व्या)
A parasite plant.
E.
षेवृ to gratify by service, यत् aff.

f. (-ता)
Rank, eminence.
E.
सेव्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, सेव्यत्त्रं.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being served, waited, attended on.
2 Being practised or used.
E.
सेव to serve, pass. v., शानच् aff.
